questions.prompt: An encoder uses future frames. Can you call it causal by sending small input chunks?
options: Yes; any small chunk makes a model causal
No; inspect and bound its future context
questions.explanation: Chunking the input does not remove the model’s future dependencies or boundary effects.

questions.prompt: A partial transcript changes on the next chunk. What should a downstream system do?
options: Assume the first partial is final
Execute irreversible actions from every partial
questions.explanation: Partial hypotheses can be revised. Downstream actions need a clear finalization and validation policy.

questions.prompt: A model processes 10 seconds of audio in 2 seconds. What is its real-time factor?
questions.explanation: RTF is processing time divided by audio duration. This throughput measure alone does not establish first-token or end-to-end latency.
